title: 56 - Descendants
summary: [[character:bob-replicant|Bob]] watches [[character:buster]] beat [[character:arnold]]'s son [[character:donald]] in an archery contest. With the gorilloid threat reduced, the Deltans number over 1,100, [[character:archimedes]]' family is growing and [[character:moses]] has died of old age. The council still upholds Bob's banishment, and stories of the bawbe are darkening.

introducing.name: Donald
introducing.description: A Deltan of [[location:delta-eridani-4|Eden]] and the son of [[character:arnold]].
introducing.current_state: At [[location:camelot]], he loses an archery contest to [[character:buster]] before the whole hexghi: uneasy but unwilling to back down, he lands a shot on the target's edge that would have crippled rather than killed.

updates.current_state: At [[location:delta-eridani]], he watches [[character:buster]] beat [[character:donald]] in an archery contest and counts the Deltans at over 1,100. Still banished by the council, he has told [[character:archimedes]] to stop arguing his case, and notes that stories of the bawbe are turning darker.

At [[location:camelot]], the tribe's foremost toolmaker cheers [[character:buster]]'s winning archery shot. He has three children and a fourth on the way. He twice raised [[character:bob-replicant]]'s banishment with the council and was rebuffed, until Bob told him to drop it.

At [[location:camelot]], he beats [[character:donald]], son of [[character:arnold]], in an archery contest before the whole hexghi, cheered on by his father [[character:archimedes]] while his younger brother and sister heckle the loser.
At [[location:camelot]], he shrugs and shouts encouragement after his son [[character:donald]]'s arrow strikes only the edge of the target in an archery contest won by [[character:buster]].
Died a few years before January 2183, aged between sixty and seventy Earth-years, a lifespan [[character:bob-replicant]] judges about equal to or a little better than a human's.

updates.state: With the gorilloid threat reduced, child mortality has fallen sharply and many new young faces have grown up; the Deltans now number over 1,100. The council still upholds [[character:bob-replicant]]'s banishment, and stories of the bawbe are growing darker.
